description: Public-safe schema contract for Clawix macOS UX trace evidence. Private runs may add redacted artifacts, but they must preserve these fields and event types.

traceIsolationContract.runDirectory: Each run must declare a per-run directory name and prove it matches the run id.
traceIsolationContract.suiteDirectory: Each suite must declare a per-suite directory name and keep child run directories relative and unique.
forbidden: absolute local paths in artifact indexes
traceIsolationContract.externalPaths: External fixture paths may be represented only by sha256 hashes; generated in-run fixture packs may be represented as paths relative to the run directory.

overheadCalibrationContract.requiredWhenNoControlRun: Evidence must explicitly record external_pending_control_run instead of silently omitting the harness-disabled comparison.
overheadCalibrationContract.controlRunPrivacy: Control artifact paths must not be written to public evidence; only artifact/path hashes and public-safe metadata are allowed.

evidenceSourcesContract.pathPolicy: Source paths must be repo-relative public artifact references, never absolute local paths.
evidenceSourcesContract.hashPolicy: Every referenced source must include a sha256 content hash so evidence can be tied to the exact registry/schema/manifest/verifier used for the run.

exitPolicyContract.p0Gate: When --gate p0 is active, FAIL and INVALID evidence must compute exit code 1 so P0 regression gates are enforceable by scripts and CI wrappers.
exitPolicyContract.dryRunWithoutGate: Dry-run evidence without an enforcing gate may stay process-successful while reporting BLOCKED evidence.

baselineComparisonContract.baselineReferencePolicy: baseline-comparison.json must not store raw external baseline paths; external baselines are represented by sha256 path hashes, while generated in-run baselines may be relative references.
baselineComparisonContract.suiteAggregationPolicy: suite-baseline-comparison.json must aggregate one comparison row per suite metric and link every child run to its own baseline-comparison.json artifact with public-safe relative paths whose runId, scenarioId, and fixtureProfile match the child run. run and suite metrics/failures artifacts must declare schemaVersion 1 and use arrays for metric and failure rows. suite artifactIndex values must be safe, existing paths and must include every required suite artifact plus every child run directory. suite status must be derived from child run statuses. suite-metrics.json and suite-failures.json must be exact aggregations of child run metrics/failures, with no extra rows, no missing rows, and no drift in required metric evidence fields such as worstSample, budget, or evidenceEventRefs.
baselineComparisonContract.rowPolicy: Every baseline comparison row must reference an emitted KPI metric, including priority, surface, p95, baseline, regressionPercent, and run/scenario/fixture context when present, and these copied metric fields must match the emitted metric row.
baselineComparisonContract.statusConsistencyPolicy: The top-level comparison status must be derived from row statuses and the active gate: missing baselines report baseline_missing, gated regressions report gate_failed, fully compared gated runs report gate_passed, and ungated complete comparisons report compared.
baselineComparisonContract.gatePolicy: A non-null gate must carry priority P0/P1/P2 and numeric maxRegressionPercent.
baselineComparisonContract.gateFailurePolicy: When a gate is active, any comparison row at the gated priority with baseline_missing or baseline_regression status must have a matching structured failures.json row, and baseline_regression must exceed the gate threshold.

baselineArtifactContract.verifierTarget: scripts/verify_macos_ux_trace_evidence.mjs must accept generated baseline JSON files in addition to run and suite directories.
baselineArtifactContract.p0Protection: Generated baselines must not allow lower-priority optimizations to update P0 baselines without approved evidence.

metricRegistryContract.policy: Every run, suite, and baseline metric row must reference a declared KPI id and must keep priority and surface equal to the KPI registry row.

metricEventReferenceContract.policy: Every run metric row must include at least one evidenceEventRefs entry, every reference must point to an event in events.jsonl, and at least one referenced event must carry the same KPI id as the metric row.
metricEventReferenceContract.purpose: Metric rows must remain auditable back to action/visual-condition timeline evidence instead of only reporting aggregate numbers.

eventLifecycleContract.policy: Each run evidence timeline must contain exactly one run.started and one run.completed event; run.completed.status must match run.json.status. If scenario.started is emitted, exactly one scenario.completed event must also be emitted. Each measured step must have exactly one step.started, exactly one action.dispatched, and exactly one terminal step.completed or step.failed event in sequence order.
eventLifecycleContract.purpose: The JSON summary and timeline lifecycle must describe the same run outcome.

failureCorrelationContract.timelinePolicy: Every failures.json row must have a matching step.failed event with the same stepId, actionId, surfaceId, controlId, and kpiId, and every step.failed event must include a failure object with a matching failures.json row so failures remain bidirectionally correlated to the action timeline.

failureStateSidecar.contentPolicy: Public artifacts must store redacted UI state only: stable trace surface IDs, enum-like roles/sources, geometry, scroll/resource numbers, booleans, and hashes/lengths for readable strings or dynamic identifiers.

normalizedSampleEvents.purpose: The runner must convert app/control-bus payload diagnostics into queryable event rows instead of leaving resource, hitch, geometry, scroll, render-window, database, or bridge facts only inside opaque payload hashes.
normalizedSampleEvents.publicSafety: Samples may contain stable IDs, redacted dynamic IDs, numeric dimensions, counts, bytes, and hashes only; they must not contain readable private conversation text or raw provider payloads.
